change.summary: Operators must submit a due diligence statement with product details, origin, and a risk confirmation before placing relevant commodities on the EU market. The statement confirms that due diligence was performed and no or only negligible risk of non-compliance with Article 3(a) or (b) was found.

obligations.text: Provide operator name, address, and EORI number in the due diligence statement.
obligations.quote: Operator’s name, address and, in the event of relevant commodities and relevant products entering or leaving the market, the Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number in accordance with Article 9 of Regulation (EU) No 952/2013.

obligations.text: Include product description, HS code, trade name, and quantity in the due diligence statement.
obligations.quote: Harmonised System code, free-text description, including the trade name as well as, where applicable, the full scientific name, and quantity of the relevant product that the operator intends to place on the market or export.

obligations.text: State country of production and geolocation of production plots in the due diligence statement.
obligations.quote: Country of production and the geolocation of all plots of land where the relevant commodities were produced.

obligations.text: Include confirmation text about due diligence and negligible risk in the statement.
obligations.quote: ‘By submitting this due diligence statement the operator confirms that due diligence in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 was carried out and that no or only a negligible risk was found that the relevant products do not comply with Article 3, point (a) or (b), of that Regulation.’.

obligations.text: Sign the due diligence statement in the required format.
obligations.quote: ‘Signed for and on behalf of: Date: Name and function: Signature:’.

reasons: This applies because you are established in Germany and sell wooden furniture and leather goods, which fall under the regulation's relevant commodities (wood and cattle).
As an operator placing these products on the EU market, you must submit a due diligence statement before the effective date.

todos.text: Collect your business name, address, and EORI number for the due diligence statement
todos.quote: Operator’s name, address and, in the event of relevant commodities and relevant products entering or leaving the market, the Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number in accordance with Article 9 of Regulation (EU) No 952/2013.

todos.text: Gather HS codes, trade names, descriptions, and quantities for each wooden and leather product you sell
todos.quote: Harmonised System code, free-text description, including the trade name as well as, where applicable, the full scientific name, and quantity of the relevant product that the operator intends to place on the market or export.

todos.text: Ask your suppliers for the country of production and geolocation of all plots where the wood and cattle were raised
todos.quote: Country of production and the geolocation of all plots of land where the relevant commodities were produced.

todos.text: Prepare the exact confirmation wording for your due diligence statement
todos.quote: ‘By submitting this due diligence statement the operator confirms that due diligence in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2023/1115 was carried out and that no or only a negligible risk was found that the relevant products do not comply with Article 3, point (a) or (b), of that Regulation.’.

todos.text: Set up the signature block with date, name, function, and signature for the statement
todos.quote: ‘Signed for and on behalf of: Date: Name and function: Signature:’.
